round_note: One 8-card machine plays and trains without stopping (5-Oct). Three cards play the games with the newest model, swapped in place in seconds; four cards train the next model back to back; one card plays the five held-out games start to end, every play with an equal share of the server. Each model is also tested on the other 20 games from fixed restart points.

panels.label: Held-out games, full play
